chunk.content: Pacific yellowfin tuna (Thunnus albacares), one species within Fishora's genus-level tuna label, has a mild, meaty flavor and firm, moist meat with large flakes.
chunk.source_quote: Yellowfin tuna has a mild, meaty flavor. It’s more flavorful than albacore, but leaner than bluefin. The meat is firm and moist, with large flakes.
